issuer: the Public Service Agency of the Ministry of Internal Affairs (შსს მომსახურების სააგენტო)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on sa.gov.ge, the Ministry of Internal Affairs' Service Agency. Its page on ages gives category B from 17; its page on terms says a licence for categories AM, A, B, BE, T, S, A1, A2 and B1 is valid for 15 years, renewed without a test on a medical certificate. The licence's fee wasn't read on a page reached, so it is null. The tests aren't held. The identity card is the ids engine's.
